newsitem.title: FRANCE: SocGen says Paribas link idea irrelevant.
newsitem.headline: SocGen says Paribas link idea irrelevant.

text.p: French bank Societe Generale dismissed a Thursday newspaper report of a possible alliance with Paribas as "irrelevant".

"More than 40 journalists attended our 1996 results news conference yesterday. La Tribune (newspaper) was the only one to believe it could detect an alliance scenario between Societe Generale and Paribas which is totally irrelevant," Societe Generale said in a one sentence statement.
Asked by Reuters, a spokesman said the statement was meant to make it clear that both the report and the idea of an alliance were irrelevant.
Earlier in the day the bank had said pending the communique it was "surprised" by the report in La Tribune.
